name.en: “You missed jury duty and there’s a warrant”: pay the fine now

how.en: A caller says you didn’t report for jury duty or missed a court date and that there is a warrant for your arrest unless you pay a fine straight away. A variant says your passport, driver’s license or professional license is expiring and must be paid for. They push for prepaid cards, crypto or a courier. The FBI counted 6,833 jury-duty and warrant complaints from January 2025 to July 2026, with nearly $36 million lost.

text.en: A caller says they are from the court or sheriff’s office.
They say you missed jury duty or court and there is a warrant.
They say paying a fine now will cancel the warrant.
They keep you on the phone until you pay.

This is Deputy Harris from the county sheriff’s office. You failed to appear for jury duty and a bench warrant has been issued. You can resolve this today by paying the fine. Stay on the line while I connect you.

en: pay a fine to cancel the warrant

en: A call demanding a fine for missed jury duty or court.
A warrant that disappears if you pay now.
Payment by prepaid card, crypto or courier.
Hang up and call your local court using the number on its official website.
Courts don’t take fines over the phone by gift card or crypto.

sources.title: Scammers Impersonating Law Enforcement and Government Officials in Fraud Schemes
